messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body. Retain the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She faces the camera and smiles gently, with subtle head tilts and blinks over the sequence.","camera":"A steady, centered medium close-up shot at eye level with no noticeable camera movement.","clothing":"A pink sleeveless top with thin black trim along the neckline and shoulders.","hair_color":"Brown with lighter highlights on the sides.","hairstyle":"Short brown bob with straight bangs and two small buns on top of her head.","identity":"A young woman with a slender build, light skin, and a soft facial expression, shown from the chest up.","scene":"A futuristic nighttime setting with a large glass-domed building, glowing circular lights, and pink and blue neon reflections on a wet ground surface."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The subject's face and skin tone were changed from a darker complexion to a lighter complexion, and facial features were altered to a different identity. The original short brown bob with bangs and two buns, pink top, futuristic scene, centered framing, and smiling action were largely retained.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's identity to match the reference photo, using the reference only for facial identity and skin tone, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the new facial identity sufficiently matches the reference photo, since the reference face is only partially visible and the output face differs in apparent age and features.
unexpected_changes: The clothing neckline changed from a broad dark panel to thin black trim, altering the original garment design.
